SELECT (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AS BUYER, #{SEQ}, /*MAX_SEQ*/ A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO,
A.CATEGORY_NO AS CATEGORY_NO, A.DESCRIPTION AS CATEGORY_TEXT,
(SELECT CATEGORY_NO FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.REG_ITEM_NO) AS CATEGORY, /*CATEGORY_NO*/ (SELECT NVL(CATEGORY_TEXT, '') FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.REG_ITEM_NO) AS CATEGORY_TEXT,
A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, (SELECT MAKER_PART_NO FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND CONTRACT_NO=A.CONTRACT_NO AND CONTRACT_SEQ=A.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS MAKER_PART_NO, /*PART_NO*/ #{AGENT} AS AGENT_CODE, /*AGENT_CODE*/ (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{BUYER} AND STATUS<>'D') AS AGENT_NAME, /*AGENT_NAME*/ A.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, #{ATOB_UNIT_PRICE} AS UNIT_PRICE, #{STOA_LIST_PRICE} AS LIST_PRICE, NVL(B.LEAD_TIME,'3') AS DELIVERY_LT, NVL(TRIM(A.ATOB_REMARK),NULL) AS REMARK, A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, /*CONTRACT_NO*/ A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, #{BTOA_USER_ID} AS PURCHASER_ID, /*PURCHASER_ID*/ NULL AS PURCHASER_NAME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(TRIM(A.REF_NO),NULL) AS REF_PR_NO, NULL AS BUYER_UNIT_PRICE, NULL AS IMGFILE_NAME, NULL AS IMGFILE_DIR, NVL(A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE,0) AS PREV_DEAL_PRICE, (SELECT BELOW_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND CONTRACT_NO=A.CONTRACT_NO AND CONTRACT_SEQ=A.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE, /*BELOW_COMORG_CODE */ (SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.REG_ITEM_NO) AS STDCATEG_ID, /*STDCATEG_ID*/ (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND CONTRACT_NO=A.CONTRACT_NO AND CONTRACT_SEQ=A.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS PROCESS_TYPE, /*PROCESS_TYPE*/ CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, A.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE, (SELECT ORIGIN_AGENT FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND CONTRACT_NO=A.CONTRACT_NO AND CONTRACT_SEQ=A.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS ORIGIN_AGENT, /*ORIGIN_AGENT*/ #{STATUS} AS STATUS, /*STATUS */ DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO),0,'S', DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG='S'), 1, 'Q','K')) AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, NULL AS ITEM_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS SELLER_ITEM_NO, A.BUYER AS COM_CODE, A.QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION AS REVISION, A.MAKER_CODE AS MAKER_CODE, DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS99999999', 'N', A.MSDS_YN) AS MSDS_YN, DECODE(A.MSDS_NO, 'MS88888888', '', A.MSDS_NO) AS MSDS_NO FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} AND A.REVISION = #{REVISION,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.STATUS <> 'O' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION = B.REVISION
)

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET ATOB_UNIT_PRICE=#{ATOB_UNIT_PRICE}, /* 1 : ATOB_UNIT_PRICE*/ ATOB_SEND_FLAG='Y', SND_CHK='N', SND_DATM=SYSDATE WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 2 : BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 3 : QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 4 : QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 5 : REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')

UPDATE ICOMCQDT SET AGENT=#{AGENT}, /* 1 : AGENT*/ TARGET_PRICE=#{BUYER_TARGET_PRICE}, /* 2 : TARGET_PRICE*/ UNIT_PRICE=#{ATOB_UNIT_PRICE}, /* 3 : UNIT_PRICE*/ LIST_PRICE=#{STOA_LIST_PRICE} /* 4 : LIST_PRICE*/ WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{BUYER} AND STATUS <> 'D') /* 5 : COM_CODE*/ AND CONTRACT_NO=#{CONTRACT_NO} /* 6 : CONTRACT_NO*/ AND CONTRACT_SEQ=#{CONTRACT_SEQ} /* 7 : CONTRACT_SEQ*/ AND STATUS <> 'D'

UPDATE ICOMBYIT SET UNIT_PRICE=#{ATOB_UNIT_PRICE} /* UNIT_PRICE*/ WHERE BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{BUYER} AND STATUS <> 'D') /* BUYER*/ AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=#{REG_ITEM_NO} /* REG_ITEM_NO*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')

UPDATE KEPQTDT SET ATOB_UNIT_PRICE = #{ATOB_UNIT_PRICE} /* 2 : 제출단가 변경 */ WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 3 : 고객사*/ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 4 : 견적번호*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 5 : 견적항번*/ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 6 : REVISION*/ AND AGENT=#{AGENT} /* 7 : 협력사*/ AND BID_SUCCESS_FLAG='Y' AND STATUS IN ('C','R')

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET RECV_FLAG='PM' /* 1 : RECV_FLAG ( PM : 품의상신 ) */ WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 2 : BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 3 : QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 4 : QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 5 : REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
